title: Coffee shop plan
goal: Let a customer find the entrance, queue, counter, seating, toilet, and back-of-house area at a glance.

rubric.must: A labeled espresso and pastry service counter is clearly visible near the customer queue.
The marked order queue is visibly separate from all customer tables and chairs.
The seating area visibly includes several small two-person tables and one longer communal table.
The prep and wash area is a separate enclosed room connected to the coffee shop by a door.
A distinct customer WC with toilet and sink symbols is visible.
A person can visually walk from the entrance to the counter, seating, toilet, and prep-room door without crossing furniture.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source, the rubric and the floorplan exemplar, without seeing the engine's own output.

review.evidence: The target shows a readable, dimensioned plan with a labeled espresso and pastry counter beside a distinct dashed order queue; four small tables with chairs and a longer communal table; and separate prep/wash and customer WC rooms with visible door openings. No material overlap or cropping blocks the requested features or circulation.

items.evidence: The labeled ESPRESSO & PASTRY COUNTER is clearly visible near the dashed ORDER QUEUE.
The dashed queue zone is above and separate from the four table-and-chair groups.
The cafe has four small two-person table settings and one longer labeled COMMUNAL TABLE.
PREP / WASH is a distinct enclosed room along the cafe’s right side, with a door opening connecting it to the cafe.
CUSTOMER WC is a distinct enclosed room with visible toilet and sink symbols.
The south entry opens into the cafe; an unobstructed central path remains between the queue/counter and seating, with access to the prep door and the WC door.
